intro: Five principles that guide how I think, make decisions, and work with others.

points.title: Curiosity is everything
points.body: The desire to learn is what I value most in a tech professional. It's a delight to hear someone speak with genuine passion for learning.

points.title: Intellectual humility
points.body: It's something we must never lose: being aware of how little we know and how much we still have to learn is what keeps us moving. Saying 'I don't know' isn't wrong — it's the starting point of all learning.

points.title: Chaos starts at the top
points.body: Strategy chaos at the leadership level cascades through the entire organization. Just look at how a lack of clear direction in leaders turns into noise, confusion, and disconnection in every team.

points.title: Questions first, solutions second
points.body: Nothing is solved well without first understanding the problem deeply. Before proposing a solution, I take the time to ask questions and understand the real context.

points.title: Learn to say NO
points.body: It's easier to say 'wait, let me look into it': I reduce the uncertainty, give you an estimated timeline, and if it's not possible, I'll give you a clear no. Saying no in time protects your focus and the team's.
